novidades: Novo no PC: controles de jogo como nos emuladores, com joystick, toque repetido, deslizar, zoom e modelos prontos para Free Fire, PUBG, Mobile Legends, Subway Surfers e outros. Abra Gamer > Editar as teclas.
novidades_en: New on the PC: emulator-style game controls with joystick, repeated tap, swipe, zoom and ready-made templates for Free Fire, PUBG, Mobile Legends, Subway Surfers and more. Open Gamer > Edit the keys.
